body:
Veteran Difficulty
==================

Designed for long-term players who think Minecraft is too easy. I made this mod for my own survival world and decided to publish it. It targets systems that fundamentally break the long-term fun of the game.

Current Features
================

One-Time Bed Spawn
------------------
- Beds only set spawn once for the entire server.
- The first successful bed use sets world spawn instead of a personal respawn point.
- After that, beds no longer change spawn points.
- Players only see the bed warning message while that one use is still available.

Dynamic Villager Trade Rerolls
------------------------------
- When a villager trade is exhausted, it is replaced with another random trade from the same profession and tier.
- This uses the live villager trade pool, so modded professions and modded trade additions are supported.
- The reroll avoids repeating the same offer when possible.

Undead Combat Changes
---------------------
- Zombies move at double speed.
- Zombie hits apply Slowness for 5 seconds.
- Skeleton hits apply Weakness for 5 seconds.

Compatibility
=============

- Minecraft 1.21
- NeoForge
- Server and singleplayer supported
